messages:
Marta (People Ops): Quick coordination: Diego's spouse needs to file H-4 + EAD renewal. They're booked for biometrics on Monday but Diego will be onsite for a critical release. Can we shift the appointment or arrange day-of coverage? :thinking_face:

Diego (Engineer): Ugh timing. I'm oncall Mon 9am-5pm. I can try to swap shifts but not sure. Can the biometrics be rescheduled to Tue?

Rina (Immig Legal): Biometrics slots vary by center. We can request a transfer but it isn't guaranteed. If Diego's spouse is willing to go alone, that's fine. We only need the principal and spouse's originals at biometric; spouse can attend without Diego.

Diego (Engineer): She prefers not to travel alone. Is there an employer letter that says it's okay to miss work for immigration? I can ask my manager about coverage but need a formal note for HR.

Marta (People Ops): We can issue a "support for immigration appointment" letter for Diego to share with his manager. Rina, can you draft the standard wording we use?

Rina (Immig Legal): Drafting now. Typical wording: "This is to confirm that the employee's spouse has a USCIS biometrics appointment on DATE at LOCATION. The appointment is related to a pending H-4/EAD renewal. We request flexibility for time off to attend." Will DM the PDF once ready.

Diego (Engineer): Thanks. Also question about courier: once EAD is approved, counsel will need passport/EAD card to return combo card. Do we pay courier or employee?

Marta (People Ops): Company covers outbound courier for visa/EAD filings and return shipping when counsel requires a secure return. Expense policy: tag as "immigration-shipping" and attach receipts within 14 days. We'll reimburse travel if spouse must go to biometric center out of town.

Diego (Engineer): Got it. If we reschedule biometrics, what's the typical wait?

Rina (Immig Legal): It depends on field office; often 2-6 weeks for next available slot. If immediate start of leave is needed, we can try to request an emergency transfer or explain conflict to field office, but success isn't guaranteed.

Diego (Engineer): Okay I'll try swapping oncall and ask manager in parallel. Marta, can you queue the manager note and Rina's letter?

Marta (People Ops): On it. I'll prepare a manager-facing note: 1) short summary, 2) expected time needed (3-4 hrs), 3) reimbursement details. Will post both docs here when ready.

Reception (bot): Reminder: if dropping documents at reception for courier pickup, label envelope "Immigration - Rina" and include a signed receipt. Reception hours 8:30-6:00.

Rina (Immig Legal): Uploaded draft letter: https://redwood.internal/legal/immigration/biometrics-support-letter-diego.pdf. Please review.

Diego (Engineer): Reviewed, looks good. Manager approved shift swap so spouse can go Monday. Thanks everyone.

Marta (People Ops): Great. Action items: Diego spouse attends biometrics Mon at 10:30; Diego to upload receipt if any travel; Marta to issue manager note and Expense template; Rina to notify counsel about biometrics completion.

ExpenseBot (bot): Expense template created: "immigration-shipping-1799801234". Attach receipts within 14 days for reimbursement.
